scope: Sim(3)-aligned trajectory RMSE auxiliary for all eight SL students and optional budget distillation.
definition: Mean per-trajectory sqrt(mean camera-position squared distance after Umeyama fit + 1e-12) - 1e-6.
fit: Detached float64 minimizing Umeyama transform; residuals retain gradients.
safeguards: Translation-only fallback for predicted-position variance <= 1e-12 m².
Fewer than three camera samples: zero auxiliary and explicit insufficient-samples diagnostic.
Existing nonfinite objective check and gradient clipping retained.
scope_of_trajectories: Current training horizon 2/4/8/12/20 seconds, complete generated flights at 20 seconds; diagnostic validation on complete held-out flights.
camera_calibration: Camera/IMU lever arm included; common initial-frame rotation preserves distance.
logging: Raw loss, coefficient, weighted contribution, scale diagnostics and degenerate/insufficient fractions in W&B and per-profile metrics.jsonl.
training_entrypoint: Existing train_students.py multi-profile auto scheduler; documented tmux command in SUPERVISED_STUDENTS_README.md.
limitations: No full training run launched or convergence/accuracy claim.
Auxiliary weight is a starting value; state/JEPA terms and selection/gating criteria remain active.
